info.title: NARA Academic Schedule & WhatsApp Reminder API
info.description: REST API for managing semesters, courses, lecturers, PICs, schedules, and automated WhatsApp reminders via Fonnte.

get.description: Returns list of all courses with semester info
Returns single course data with schedules
Returns list of all course PICs (Penanggung Jawab Mata Kuliah)

post.description: Creates a new course PIC record

get.description: Returns single course PIC data
Returns list of all holidays with optional filters

post.summary: Create new holiday or holiday range
post.description: Create a single-day holiday or a bulk date-range holiday (e.g. semester break)

get.summary: Check if today or specific date is a holiday
get.description: Checks whether a date is within an active holiday

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date in Y-m-d format. Defaults to today.

post.description: Fetch and save national holidays from public API / package into database

get.description: Returns paginated list of kas expenses ordered by expense date

post.description: Creates a new class treasury expense record

get.description: Returns single kas expense detail

post.description: Toggles a student payment status between paid and unpaid for a specific week

get.summary: Get students checklist for a week
get.description: Returns all active students with their payment status for treasurer one-tap interface
Returns total balance, total income, total expenses, active week, and recent activity
Returns all students with their payment status across recent weeks (for public transparency table)
Returns list of kas weeks with payment counts and total collected

post.summary: Create new kas week or incidental due
post.description: Creates a new kas week period or incidental due (e.g. lomba, kegiatan)

get.description: Returns single kas week record

delete.description: Deletes a kas week record and associated payments

get.description: Returns list of all lecturers
Returns single lecturer data

post.summary: Test WhatsApp message delivery via Fonnte
post.description: Sends a test WhatsApp message to verify Fonnte gateway configuration

post.summary: Manually trigger H-1 Afternoon Reminders (16:00 WIB)
post.description: Triggers the 16:00 WIB afternoon reminder for tomorrow's classes (or a specific overridden day)
Triggers the 05:00 AM morning reminder for today's classes (or a specific overridden day)

post.summary: Manually trigger Daily Task Reminder (18:00 WIB)
post.description: Triggers the daily task reminder to the class WhatsApp group

get.description: Returns delivery history and status of automated WhatsApp reminders
Returns list of class schedules with filters for day, semester, and active status

post.description: Creates a new academic class schedule

get.description: Returns single schedule data
Returns list of all semesters
Returns single semester data
Returns paginated list of students ordered by attendance number. Filterable by is_active and search.
Returns single student record
Returns list of tasks with course information. Filterable by course_id and status (completed/pending)

get.description: Returns single task data with course

patch.description: Toggles between completed and incomplete status

post.description: Processes incoming messages, evaluates bot commands (!tugas, !jadwal, !dosen, !help), and responds accordingly
